evidence.candidate_probe: process.versions.openssl reported the 3.0 line and the new prevention gate failed closed

customer_impact: No production exposure is claimed because the candidate remains staging-only and not production-approved. Promotion with an EOL cryptographic runtime would create unsupported future security-fix risk.
